app.title: Show HN: A 15 MB self-hosted Netflix and Spotify for your media server
app.description: A lightweight, self‑hosted media server that aggregates content from Netflix, Spotify and other sources.
proposed_tests: Clone the repo and run `npm install` (or `yarn install`).
Start the server with `npm start` and verify the web UI loads at localhost:3000.
Add a sample media URL via the API and confirm it streams correctly.
Measure startup time and memory usage compared to a similar lightweight server.
